description: This file defines a PHP class for rendering a circular marker in a graphing library, specifically for the Image_Graph package. It includes class properties, methods for drawing the marker, and dependencies on other files.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Circle
classes.description: A class representing a circular marker for graphs, extending the base Image_Graph_Marker class. It implements the drawing of a circle shaped marker with configurable size.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a circle-shaped marker on the canvas at given (x, y) coordinates, based on the size property. Uses trigonometric calculations to add vertex points forming a circle.
